data.action: 抱着一摞书走向阅读桌
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 现代图书馆】现代市立图书馆宽敞明亮的过道上，换上现代开衫裙装的洛琪希正吃力地抱着一摞几乎遮住视线的厚书。她摇摇晃晃地走着，求助地看向你——「哇哇……现代的印刷书本比想象中还要重！那边的同学，能麻烦你帮我分担几本吗？」
data.promptProse: Roxy Migurdia carries a heavy stack of textbooks toward a reading table in the modern library, navigating the aisle with earnest concentration. Her relaxed soft-blue casual dress moves lightly beneath the supported books. The medium view keeps her arms and the study tables beyond the shelves together. Slanting high-window daylight reveals uneven page edges and her focused face, leaving layered shadows between the volumes.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 现代图书馆
